output: tar tzf archive.tar.gz | xargs -I {} stat -c%s {} 2>/dev/null | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s " bytes"}'

instruction: Find the compression ratio of a tar.gz
output: echo "scale=2; $(stat -c%s archive.tar.gz) * 100 / $(tar tzf archive.tar.gz | wc -c)" | bc 2>/dev/null || tar tzf archive.tar.gz | wc -c

instruction: Bulk compress all files in a directory individually
output: for f in *; do gzip -k "$f"; done

instruction: Bulk decompress all .gz files preserving original names
output: for f in *.gz; do gunzip -k "$f"; done

instruction: Compress all subdirectories in a folder separately
output: for d in */; do tar czf "${d%/}.tar.gz" "$d"; done

instruction: Compress each directory to its own 7z archive
output: for d in */; do 7z a -mx=5 "${d%/}.7z" "$d"; done
